revised:
This PRD defines a unified multi-agent development system for AI-assisted software development. The system combines distributed coordination, structured workflows, radical minimalism, and engineering fundamentals.

Reduces code by 53%, cost by 26%, time by 41%. Persists context across crashes. Coordinates 20-30+ agents.

changes.before: designed to address the fundamental challenges of AI-assisted software development at scale
changes.reason: Generic claim; the challenges are never named, and removing the phrase keeps every fact in the sentence.
Generic claim with no detail; removing it keeps every fact in the sentence.

kept: Fragment style of the third paragraph ("Reduces code by 53%..."): terse and carries the facts.
"radical minimalism": a named design principle of the system, not filler.

flags.issue: "distributed coordination, structured workflows, radical minimalism, and engineering fundamentals" names four approaches without saying what each does in this system. The author must supply a concrete description for each.
"Reduces code by 53%, cost by 26%, time by 41%" gives no baseline, source or measurement method. The author must supply them.
"20-30+ agents" gives no context for what is coordinated or under which conditions. The author must supply it if it matters.
